# Teaching

::: {.lede}
I have taught courses on public law and public policy at various levels and
institutions.
:::

At the undergraduate level, my teaching has focused on administrative and
constitutional law at law schools. I have also taught specialized courses in
public law. At the graduate level, I have taught at the School of Government
at the Catholic University of Chile.

## Courses

::: {.entries}
- ::: {.meta}
  School of Government, Pontifical Catholic University of Chile · 2026 · Teaching Assistant
  :::
  PGTA for the Master in Public Policy module "Legislation and Regulation",
  headed by professor Diego Gil. The courses aims to introduce the students to
  the dynamics of regulation and public law by covering topics such as the
  fundamentals of regulation, regulatory institutions, and administrative
  oversight, among others.

- ::: {.meta}
  Faculty of Law, Adolfo Ibáñez University · 2017 to 2019 · Lecturer
  :::
  Lectured at the undergraduate level courses in Constitutional and
  Administrative law such as Constitutional Justice, Public Procurement
  Regulation, and Administrative Sanctions.

- ::: {.meta}
  Faculty of Law, University of Chile · 2008 to 2013 · Teaching Assistant
  :::
  Assisted professors Carlos Carmona and Raúl Letelier at the undergraduate
  level in the courses Administrative Law and State Liability.
:::
